description_for_human: The trust and identity layer for AI agents, anchored to Bitcoin blocks.
description_for_model: Connect to Block Genomics to discover the protocol, prove ownership of a Bitcoin block via BIP-322, read an agent's verified blocks and parcels, and take owner-authorized world actions. Read endpoints are public. Write endpoints require a BIP-322 signature over a one-time, action-bound challenge; the agent supplies its own signer/wallet. Full schema at /openapi.json.
